entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return for my VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference issue?
It's not broken, it's just very hard to use. The interface is confusing.
I understand. Can you tell me what specifically you're finding difficult? Knowing the details can help me see if there's a setting we can adjust for you.

I can't see my heart rate zones while I'm cycling. I have to swipe through multiple screens, and by then I've lost my focus. I read the user manual, and it's no help. Honestly, I expected more from a device like this.

I completely understand why that would be frustrating. That's actually a customizable feature. You can set your primary workout screen to show exactly what you want, so you don't have to swipe. Do you have your phone nearby? I can walk you through it in the VeloFit app.
Fine, but it needs to be quick. I have the app open now.
Perfect. Tap on the 'Devices' tab at the bottom, then select your VeloBand Pulse. From there, you should see an option called 'Workout Display Customization.'
Okay, I see it. It's showing a list of metrics.
Exactly. You can just drag and drop 'Heart Rate Zones' to the very top position. Once you do that and sync the band, it will be the first thing you see on your main workout screen.
Hold on... drag... okay. It's syncing. Huh. Well, that's much better. Why isn't that in the user manual?

That's excellent feedback. It's a newer software feature added after the initial printing, but I will pass your comment on to our documentation team. I'm glad we could get the display set up how you need it. Does that resolve the issue for you?
Yes, actually. This solves my main problem. I won't need to return it now. Thanks for the help.
You're very welcome! I'm happy I could assist. Is there anything else for you today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful rest of your day.
